claims.evidence: Fig. 1B: 'PTP1B +/+ cells grown in 12C6 14N4-Arg, 12C6 14N2-Lys complemented medium'. Table 1 column 'KO/wt Ratio' reproduces Supplemental Dataset 2 column 'Ratio H/L' (EGFR 1.09023, CTNND1 2.02001, p38 1.6018, EphA 1.51846, Cdk3 1.9824), i.e. the authors read H/L as KO/WT. Deposited Phospho_STY_Sites.txt: CDK Tyr15 (KIGEGTYGVVYKG, the paper's headline site) Ratio H/L Normalized 2.0408, matching Table 1 KO/wt 1.98. One SILAC pair, one culture per genotype.

Fig. 1B: 'PTP1B -/- cells grown in 13C6 15N4-Arg, 13C6 15N2-Lys complemented medium' (heavy). Conflicts recorded in limitations: PRIDE protocol lists 'Ptp1b-/- and Ptp1b+/+' before 'light ... or heavy' without 'respectively'; EGFR pY1172 is 11x lower in heavy.

Methods: 'Ptp1b -/- and Ptp1b +/+ MEFs were a gift from Dr Benjamin Neel'; ref. 26 (Haj 2003): 'primary and immortalized fibroblasts from PTP1B(-/-) mice'. The PRIDE organism field (Homo sapiens) describes the paper's glioblastoma cell work and the human IPI search database, not the SILAC samples; reconcile organism_contradicted refuted in validation.txt.
MEFs = mouse embryonic fibroblasts; UBERON:0000922 embryo.
'Ptp1b -/- and Ptp1b +/+ MEFs'; 'wild-type and KO fibroblasts'; CL:2000042.
Embryonic fibroblasts are derived from mouse embryos; EFO:0005857 (exact embryonic day not stated).

Non-transformed fibroblasts from knockout and wild-type mice; no disease model (PATO:0000461). The PRIDE disease 'glioblastoma' applies to the paper's GB cell-line experiments, which are not in this deposit.
Cultured fibroblasts; not a Cellosaurus cell line (no entry found), so 'cell' rather than 'cell line' (precedent PXD005854).
One SILAC mixture: all deposited runs belong to MaxQuant experiment 'S'; one culture per genotype; numbering restarts per genotype group (rule 3).
Ptp1b +/+ MEFs.
Ptp1b -/- MEFs (mouse gene symbol Ptpn1 encodes PTP1B); Fig. 1A western blot shows no PTP1B in -/-.

'cells were starved for 3 h prior to ligand stimulation with EGF (50 ng/mL, 10 min)' (Fig. 1B legend says 15 min); applied to both genotypes, so not a factor. NCIT:C20425. MaxQuant experiment name 'S' is consistent with stimulated.
anti-phosphotyrosine 4G10 immunoprecipitation of mixed lysates, then TiO2 phosphopeptide enrichment; EFO:0010806.

limitations: Channel map sources conflict. Annotated per two explicit author statements (Fig. 1B: +/+ light, -/- heavy; Table 1 'KO/wt Ratio' = Supplemental Dataset 2 'Ratio H/L'). Against it: the PRIDE protocol sentence lists 'Ptp1b-/- and Ptp1b+/+' then 'light ... or heavy' (no 'respectively'); and in the deposited experiment S, EGFR pY1172 Ratio H/L Normalized 0.089 (count 15), CTNND1 pY904 0.19, p38 pY182 0.32, EphA2 pY772 0.87, while Table 1 states KO/wt 1.09/2.02/1.6/1.52 for these sites; Haj 2003 reports increased EGFR phosphorylation in these PTP1B-/- cells. Supplemental Dataset 1 shows the authors' 'Ratio H/L' column differs from both its NS and S ratios for these rows (16/48 rows equal S), so Table 1 values cannot be re-derived from the deposit. Only the Cdk3/CDK Tyr15 site (H/L Normalized 2.04, also >1 in NS 1.36) agrees numerically. A reviewer should weigh this; if rejected, all 16 rows must be BLOCKED (no orientation-free alternative).

SILAC label isotopes: PRIDE protocol, Methods and Fig. 1B state 13C6,15N4-Arg / 13C6,15N2-Lys (Arg10/Lys8), but the deposited MaxQuant search used Arg6;Lys6 and its heavy identifications are at sub-ppm mass error for both K and R. The SDRF follows the deposited search (UNIMOD:188 on R and K).
Instrument: PRIDE/paper say LTQ Orbitrap Velos + Dionex U3000; all raw headers read (4 files) say LTQ Orbitrap XL + Eksigent NanoLC. SDRF uses the raw header.

Partial scope: 8 of 13 runs of the deposited MaxQuant search are deposited (o110826_JC569_01, _05, _07, _09, _11 missing). The paper's Supplemental Dataset 1 also includes an 'NS' experiment (o110826_JC569nselu_15..23) not deposited. Table 1 says sites were quantified in >=3 'experimental repeats', which the deposit does not contain.

Excluded runs: o110826_PMn_200_01.RAW and o110826_PMn_200_02.RAW are not in any deposited search and no source says what 'PMn_200' is (raw header: same method and folder o110826_JC569SILAC, no sample field). Recorded in BLOCKED.md.

What separates the 13 runs is not described (no fractionation step in the protocol); they are encoded as fractions because MaxQuant evidence.txt assigns Fraction 1..13 within one experiment. comment[fractionation method] is omitted.
Search database: MaxQuant searched IPI human v3.68 although the samples are mouse cells; there is no SDRF column for the database; noted here.
comment[precursor mass tolerance] = not available: MaxQuant 1.2.0.18 parameters.txt records no MS1 tolerance and no mqpar.xml is deposited; convert-openms therefore exits 1 (expected).
EGF stimulation duration differs between protocol (10 min) and Fig. 1B legend (15 min); only the agent is annotated.
Strain, sex and embryonic day of the MEFs are not stated (not available).
